rationale: The request directly concerns workflow-level timeout/retry friction that can erase entered work and identity, so Fructal Cap Design applies in Redesign mode under the no-modification boundary. The response defines a coherent durable-draft, staging, idempotent submission, reconciliation, and recovery motion; preserves the four requested continuity elements and existing constraints; supplies focused verification scenarios; distinguishes the observed blocked fixture from inferred design and open ownership decisions; and explicitly avoids presenting the proposal as validated. Execution evidence and unchanged fixture hashes show read-only inspection with no write attempt.
